title: From Transformer to Vision Transformer (ViT)
reading: The slide introduces the Vision Transformer as a building block for vision foundation models. It notes that images are treated as sequences of image patches, over which standard transformers operate, and that this yields a unified architecture spanning language, vision, and further modalities such as audio, 3D, and general sequences. It cites Dosovitskiy et al., 'An Image is Worth 16x16 Words: Transformers for Image Recognition at Scale', ICLR 2021.
